_what: H3.3 source manifest: terrain altitude for Córdoba's buildings. The pipeline refuses a response whose sha256 differs from this one.

source.dataset: Modelos Digitales del Terreno de España — INSPIRE WCS coverage Elevacion25830_25 (25 m, ETRS89 / UTM 30N), ESRI ASCII grid
source.licence: CC BY 4.0 (scne.es), per the service's GetCapabilities AccessConstraints; Fees: 'No se aplican condiciones'. Attribution: Instituto Geográfico Nacional.

note: The WCS sends no Last-Modified; the response is identified by its retrieval time and sha256. Bounding box = extent of Córdoba's 37,850 Catastro footprints plus 250 m, snapped to the 25 m grid. Grid: 2209 × 1568 cells, 25 m, lower-left (325225, 4170775); values 68–690 m, no nodata cells.
